tool_signatures.name: create_workout
tool_signatures.description: Create a structured workout in Garmin Connect: always a new one, never an edit.

name.description: Shown in Garmin Connect and on the watch.

steps.description: Ordered steps, each with "type" (warmup, interval, recovery, rest, cooldown or repeat) and exactly one of "duration_seconds", "distance_meters" or "until_lap": true (ends on the lap button: a walk recovery between strides, a warm-up by feel, a rep to a landmark). A repeat is {"type": "repeat", "times": 5, "steps": [...]} and can't contain another repeat. Optional target: "pace" ("4:05" or ["4:00", "4:10"], min/km), "hr" ([150, 165] bpm, or their Garmin zone: "z2", "z3-z4") or "power" (watts, 250 or [240, 260]; a share of the FTP set in Garmin, "95%" or ["88%", "94%"]; or a power zone, "z3"). By default only the work reps carry a target (pace for a run); warm-ups, cool-downs and recoveries carry none, and the description says what easy pace to run them at: marathon pace plus 45-75 s/km, from get_fitness. The watch beeps off target, so a pace target is never narrower than 5 s/km either side ("4:00" becomes 3:55-4:05; tighter is widened around its middle): about 5 either side for reps, 10 for tempo and threshold, 15-20 for steady and long runs, or heart rate for easy running. A ride uses power on the work steps when the rider has a power meter or smart trainer (power shows on rides in get_activities) and an FTP (get_fitness): sweet spot 88-94%, threshold 95-105%, VO2 max 106-120%, endurance 56-75%. One value becomes a range 5% either side. Without a power meter, heart rate. E.g. 15 min warm-up, 5 x 1 km at 4:05, 90 s recoveries, 10 min cool-down: [{"type": "warmup", "duration_seconds": 900}, {"type": "repeat", "times": 5, "steps": [{"type": "interval", "distance_meters": 1000, "pace": "4:05"}, {"type": "recovery", "duration_seconds": 90}]}, {"type": "cooldown", "duration_seconds": 600}]

sport.description: running (default), cycling, swimming, walking or hiking.

description.description: Optional note stored with the workout.

pool_length_meters.description: For a swim, 25 (default) or 50; the watch counts lengths with it.

tool_signatures.name: garmin_official
tool_signatures.description: Preview: Daash on Garmin's official API, tried with your own account first.

action.description: "status" says whether this account is connected and what Garmin has sent so far; "connect" gives a link to approve Daash on Garmin's own sign-in page; "test_workout" sends an easy 20-minute run through Garmin's Training API, scheduled on `date`; "disconnect" says what ending the official link loses, and "disconnect_confirmed" then ends it and deletes what Garmin sent; "activities" reads the recent activities Garmin sent, with splits and laps; "days" reads each recent day's sleep, HRV, resting heart rate, stress, Body Battery, steps and VO2 max; "official_only" answers the day, sleep and activity tools from Garmin's official API alone, and "both" goes back to Garmin Connect for them; "calendar" asks Garmin's Training API what is scheduled from `date` for the following six weeks, to see whether it lists only what Daash scheduled or everything on the calendar; "weekly_email" sends this account's Monday email to its own address now, as it would go out next Monday; "friends" lists Bart's friends using Daash, and "add_friends" or "remove_friends" changes that list from `emails`. A friend's PostHog profile is marked friend, for the friends cohort.

date.description: For test_workout, the day to schedule it on.

emails.description: For add_friends and remove_friends, addresses separated by commas; "crew" among them adds everyone in your crew on Daash.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: "status" says whether this account is connected and what Garmin has sent so far; "connect" gives a link to approve Daash on Garmin's own sign-in page; "test_workout" sends an easy 20-minute run through Garmin's Training API, scheduled on `date`; "disconnect" says what ending the official link loses, and "disconnect_confirmed" then ends it and deletes what Garmin sent; "activities" reads the recent activities Garmin sent, with splits and laps; "days" reads each recent day's sleep, HRV, resting heart rate, stress, Body Battery, steps and VO2 max; "official_only" answers the day, sleep and activity tools from Garmin's official API alone, and "both" goes back to Garmin Connect for them; "calendar" asks Garmin's Training API what is scheduled from `date` for the following six weeks, to see whether it lists only what Daash scheduled or everything on the calendar; "weekly_email" sends this account's Monday email to its own address now, as it would go out next Monday; "friends" lists Bart's friends using Daash, and "add_friends" or "remove_friends" changes that list from `emails`. A friend's PostHog profile is marked friend, for the friends cohort.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: For test_workout, the day to schedule it on.

parameters.name: emails
parameters.description: For add_friends and remove_friends, addresses separated by commas; "crew" among them adds everyone in your crew on Daash.

tool_signatures.description: Change the user's details in their Daash crew, or the crew's own settings.

Give them the page_url to pin in the group chat's description.
